title: Shortest Distance to a Character
description: Given a string s and a character c, return an array of integers representing the shortest distance from each character in s to the character c in s.
pseudocode:
1. n = s.length
2. res = new Array(n)
3. prev = -Infinity
4. for i from 0 to n-1:
5.   if s[i] == c: prev = i
6.   res[i] = i - prev
7. prev = Infinity
8. for i from n-1 down to 0:
9.   if s[i] == c: prev = i
10.  res[i] = min(res[i], abs(i - prev))

steps.note: Initialize result array with length of s
Forward pass: calculate distance to nearest 'e' on the left
Backward pass: calculate distance to nearest 'e' on the right
